completion_data.completion_summary: Settled FrameClass.Dedekind negatively. Added the four .Dedekind instantiations of the FrameClass-indexed compactness family to SetConsequence.lean, and a new 516-line module FormalSystem/Metalogic/DedekindNonCompactness.lean carrying the witness {G(T S -q), F(G -q)} u {Xq^n T : n in N} — finitely satisfiable over an R ShiftSet model, unsatisfiable over every Dedekind-complete frame — which refutes CompactDedekind (dedekind_consequence_not_compact) and StrongCompletenessDedekind (strongCompletenessDedekind_refuted), both sorry-free at exactly [propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound]. Reconciled 15 documentation hunks across five files that previously asserted the tree contained no Dedekind refutation.
